details: Bitcoin dropped below key support levels, erasing early October gains, with its price falling below $83,000. This market correction triggered significant liquidations of leveraged long positions, totaling over $693 million across the crypto market. Factors contributing to the downturn include renewed geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices, with analysts anticipating Bitcoin to consolidate between $81,300 and $86,500 ahead of the upcoming CPI report.
title: Bitcoin Faces Decline Amid Macro Headwinds and Liquidations

details: Ethereum spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced substantial net outflows, with $160.9 million withdrawn on October 7, 2026, contributing to a five-day total exceeding $506 million. This marks the largest five-day outflow since January 2026, with BlackRock's ETHA and Grayscale's ETHE leading the redemptions. This sustained outflow puts downward pressure on Ethereum's price.
title: Ethereum Spot ETFs Record Over $500M in Outflows

details: A federal jury in Manhattan found a security consultant guilty of computer fraud and money laundering related to a $53.3 million exploit of the decentralized exchange Uranium Finance in 2021. The verdict, reached on October 7, 2026, rejected the "Code is Law" defense, establishing a significant legal precedent regarding smart contract vulnerabilities in the U.S.
title: DeFi Exploit Hacker Found Guilty in $53.3 Million Case

details: Justin Drake, an Ethereum Foundation researcher, urged the crypto industry to prepare for a "bunker mode" scenario involving a controlled migration of funds. This proactive measure addresses a hypothetical future where AI could potentially assist in breaking ECDSA cryptography before quantum computing advancements, known as "Q-Day." Drake emphasized this is a preparedness warning, not an indication of an immediate threat.
title: Ethereum Researcher Warns of AI-Assisted Crypto Break

details: XRP is increasingly integrated into decentralized finance (DeFi) with Firelight activating coverage for DeFi vaults on Flare. This initiative provides built-in risk management and safeguards against technical and economic failures for DeFi investment products, utilizing FXRP (XRP on Flare) for backing. This enhances the security and reliability of DeFi offerings using XRP.
title: XRP Expands DeFi Utility with Firelight Vault Protection

details: Universal Safety Products Inc. (Nasdaq: UUU) announced its name change to DeFi Capital Markets, Inc., effective October 19, 2026, with its stock trading under the new ticker DCM on NYSE American. This rebranding signifies a strategic shift to focus entirely on tokenization, digital assets, quantitative trading, and blockchain-based financial markets, signaling a traditional public company's full embrace of the DeFi sector.
title: Universal Safety Products Rebrands to DeFi Capital Markets

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) announced it would cease its weekly Ethereum buying program after accumulating 5% of the circulating supply. This news led to a decline in Bitmine shares by 7% and negatively impacted other crypto-related stocks like Sharplink and Strategy, as a significant institutional buyer exits the regular accumulation of Ethereum.
sourceName: MarketWatch (based on content referring to "Market Movers desk" and stock analysis)
title: Bitmine Halts Weekly Ethereum Purchases, Impacts Crypto Stocks
